name: Clover
grown_as: White clover: a native perennial of lawns and grassland, also sown as green manure and for bees. 'Clover' in the library is taken to mean white clover; red clover has its own entry. ⚠️ CHECK
habit: Low and creeping: stems run flat along the ground, rooting at each joint, making mats. Leaves and flower heads stand up 5 to 20 cm on long stalks straight from the runners. Hairless.

leaf.arrangement: Single leaves at each joint of the creeping stem, standing up on long stalks
leaf.type: Compound: three leaflets (trifoliate) from the top of one stalk
leaf.leaflets: All three almost stalkless and alike, meeting at one point
leaf.outline: Each leaflet broadly oval to rounded-obovate, 1 to 3 cm, widest above the middle
leaf.tip: Rounded, often with a small notch
leaf.veins: Many fine straight side veins, clearer when held to the light
leaf.surface: Hairless, slightly glossy, usually with a whitish V-shaped band (chevron) across each leaflet
leaf.stalk: Long (5 to 20 cm), thin, hairless; papery pale stipules at the base wrapping the runner
leaf.colour: Mid green with a pale chevron

flower.form: A round ball made of many tiny pea flowers
flower.petals: Each small flower a narrow pea flower, the standard longer than the rest
flower.colour: White or cream, often tinged pink; the older lower flowers turn brown
flower.centre: None; the head is the same all through
flower.behind: Tiny green calyces; no leaves under the head
flower.carried: Heads alone at the top of long leafless stalks from the runners, standing above the leaves. Each small flower on a short stalk and, once over, bends down so the head has a skirt of drooping brown flowers below the fresh white ones.

fruit: Small pods hidden in the dry, brown, drooping flowers of the old head; 3 to 4 tiny heart-shaped yellow to brown seeds
seedling: Two small oval seed leaves, then a first true leaf with a single round leaflet (spade-shaped), then three-leaflet leaves.
winter: Green all winter in mild areas: a low mat of small three-leaflet leaves on the creeping stems

leaf: three rounded leaflets from the top of one long stalk
a whitish V-shaped band on each leaflet
bloom: a round white ball of many tiny pea flowers
older flowers turned down and brown at the bottom
young: a creeping stem rooting at the joints
leaves standing up on long stalks
flower: round white heads on long leafless stalks
standing above a low mat of three-leaflet leaves
seedhead: heads of dry brown flowers bent downward
dormant: a low green mat of small three-leaflet leaves

look_alikes: Red clover is upright, hairy, with pink-purple heads sitting on a pair of leaves. Alsike clover (Trifolium hybridum) has pink-white heads but no chevron and does not root along its stems. Black medick has tiny yellow heads and a stalked middle leaflet. Wood sorrel has heart-shaped folding leaflets and single white flowers.
